verdict.rationale: Numeral tracks nexus position and thresholds per jurisdiction and manages filings/registrations, and its API/MCP exposes transactions, sales, and calculations that could underpin liability tracking, but there is no explicit documentation of a 'collected vs owed' liability view or accountant/GL-ready exports. missing for 10: explicit accrued liability by jurisdiction report, collected-vs-owed breakdown, documented GL/accountant export formats (e.g., CSV/QBO sync).
